text.tspan: Five numbers that describe a link: the motorway picture
The link = a motorway · lanes = bandwidth
to get from A to B
A wide motorway (high bandwidth) is still a slow trip if it is long (latency) or blocked (loss).
Bandwidth problems: a bigger pipe. Latency problems: move closer (CDN, region) or make fewer round trips.
latency: how long ONE packet takes from A to B
